shared_elements: carved low-relief detailing on a flat surface
justification: Both surfaces depict human-like figures and include a circular disc motif and horizontal patterned bands, but these are generic elements that almost any carving tradition could produce. A is a single massive schematic body seen from behind, its back covered with abstract rings, curved lines and a belt-like band, whereas B is a naturalistic narrative relief of two elaborately coiffed figures facing one another and exchanging/holding bowl-like objects, with fringed garments and rendered musculature — the depicted subject, relationships and rendering conventions have essentially nothing specific in common.
